title: symphyotrichum foliaceum var. parryi
intro: Symphyotrichum foliaceum var. parryi, commonly known as Parry's aster or Parry's white aster, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions, including fever and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Parry's aster include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic, suggesting its potential in treating pain, wounds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Parry's aster include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its health benefits.
